name: gentle-steps-android-shell
description: Android shell for 24 Gentle Steps to Christmas

scripts.android:generate: npm run web:prepare && rm -rf android && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npm run android:brand
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:generate && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:generate && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
